messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy failed for release v2.9.1 (canary -> main) — SBOM provenance check FAILED. Blocked. Package 'redis-client' digest mismatch.

deploy-bot: ```expected: sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\nfound:    sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb``` 

mia (eng-release): Which job flagged it? can we get the SBOM artifact / full report?

deploy-bot: sbom-scan-job/2.9.1-1 returned provenance_mismatch; full report uploaded: gs://redwood-ci/sbom-reports/1795000123/2.9.1/report.json

sam (security): @mia @lee assigning. Looks like a provenance chain break — could be base image or a repackaged upstream artifact. We need artifact trace + vuln check. Blocking release until sign-off.

anita (qa): We saw a flaky redis-client failure in staging last night (2/100). Might be related.

lee (sre): Can we pin to the prior working digest in the deployment manifest and re-run canary? Alternatively rebuild with pinned base image and re-run scans.

jordan (pm): Release owner here. Timeline? We had a customer-facing change window tonight 00:00-02:00 UTC. If this holds past the window we'll need a customer update.

sam (security): Security asks for: 1) artifact trace showing builder job and creds 2) SBOM provenance details 3) vuln scan. If we can't verify quickly we should rollback to v2.9.0.

mia (eng-release): I can run a quick bisect and check build logs + vendor signatures. ETA ~40m.

deploy-bot: Automatic rollback not triggered (manual-approval-required). Recommended actions: `/deploy rollback v2.9.0` or `/deploy pin-image sha256:aaaaaaaa...` on canary.

anita (qa): If we rollback I'll update release notes and changelog to reflect the rollback and customer-facing blurb.

jordan (pm): Ok prioritizing safety. @sam please confirm approval for rollback if needed.

sam (security): Approve rollback to v2.9.0 for canary + hold main. I will formally sign off once artifact trace is attached.

mia (eng-release): Found root cause: CI used `alpine:3.18` base image for this build instead of pinned `alpine:3.17` — explains digest delta. CI base-image auto-update caused rebuild divergence. Patching CI to pin base image now.

lee (sre): Nice find. If Mia can rebuild with pinned base and we pass sbom + vuln scans we can avoid rollback and resume.

jordan (pm): Decision: prefer rebuild-and-retest. Plan: rebuild now, run sbom and vuln scan, then promote canary if green. If not green by 00:50 UTC, rollback at 01:10 UTC. I'll notify customers about the tentative windows.

sam (security): Security checklist for proceed: artifact trace attached, SBOM pass, vuln scan clear. If rebuild satisfies, I will sign off.

anita (qa): I'll wire up smoke tests to run post-rebuild and add an alert rule for redis-client error rate spikes.

deploy-bot: Holding release. Manual blocker tag applied. Scheduled change window check at 00:00 UTC and deploy reminders 15m before decision.

jordan (pm): :thumbsup: Thanks all — keep this thread updated. I'll post the release-note amendment if we end up rolling back.

ops-bot: Noted. Pager duty on-call alerted for rollback window: @oncall-sre.
